contentHtml:
The Independent Research Project (IRP) is a course where students pursue their own research themes with the guidance of a full-time faculty member from the Department of Economics, with the objective of completing a thesis or creative work within one year. The IRP for PEARL is conducted in English. Students are responsible for selecting their own research themes, actively engaging with their supervisors, and demonstrating a strong commitment and determination to carry out the research. This course can be taken alongside research seminars (zemi) and the Professional Career Programme (PCP).

(Accepting Double Degree)
